newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Margins crushed on data.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Margins crushed on data.

text.p: The Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread narrowed to around 50 basis points after Thursday's extremely weak labour force report for May sparked speculation of a further easing in monetary policy.
Analysts said the margin is now at its lowest level in more than three years, and a clear break of the 50 basis point level will take it to a level not seen in over a decade.
"For many traders in the market now we are in uncharted territory," said Su-Lin Ong, fixed interest economist at Hambros Bank Australia. "The question is now, can we do a Canada?"
The Canadian/U.S. 10-year spread has been negative for sometime, and the 30-year spread between the two almost went to parity for the first time ever.

Local yield spreads to Canada also squeezed in sharply on the day, although they were little changed to New Zealand, which also rallied strongly on a higher N.Z. TWI and after a further flurry of Eurokiwi issues.
